definitions.gloss: anything and everything; indiscriminately; without distinction
definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that something applies to absolutely everything without exception or selection. Often carries a tone of exasperation or criticism about a lack of discernment.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまう。
examples.english: I end up buying anything and everything.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to look up absolutely everything on the internet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{頼|たよ}っていたら→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧、⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you rely on your parents for absolutely everything, you'll never be able to stand on your own.

notes:
An emphatic variant of ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anything). The repetitive pattern with かん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ intensifies the meaning to "absolutely everything without distinction." The かん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ part has no independent meaning — it is a rhyming echo used for emphasis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy anything and everything)
- {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (to believe anything and everything)
- {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (to rely on others for everything)
- {何|なん}でもかんでも⟦{禁止|きんし}する→禁止する：22145_kinshisuru⟧ (to ban anything and everything)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — anything; neutral, without the emphatic or critical nuance
- ⟦{何|なに}もかも→何もかも：26777_nanimokamo⟧ — everything; similar emphasis but sounds slightly more literary
- {手当|てあ}たり⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ — at random, indiscriminately; focuses on random selection

USAGE:
This expression often appears in complaints or criticism, suggesting that someone is being indiscriminate or excessive. It is colloquial and conversational in tone.
